reviews.title: Unfair Experience

Too pricey for the value it gives, the one year subscription fee is definitely unfair especially that there are other apps much cheaper or even free
The chat also is always lagging or freezing making conversations nearly impossible.
While the goal of this app is to benefit people, I would say it is not being done with good morals especially tricking people with the one year subscription fee.

reviews.title: Improvement
reviews.text: I downloaded this app so I can learn more about Islam and get to know more about Islam generally. Once it had finished downloading I was in joy so I can know more about Islam but I did not know there was a subscription behind this. To continue with this app you need to pay for a subscription which is £30. Due to this matter I was very disappointed because you should not need to pay to know about Islam you should not need to pay to get you more into Islam it should all be free. It was even more disappointing to know that you access anything at all without paying for this subscription. This is also a bad example that they are setting. People from different religions such as Christians Buddhisms Judaisms or even Atheists may want to revert to Islam and they probably have downloaded this app and they realised they have to pay a subscription to continue on this app they must think I have to pay for every app to know more about Islam or to be Muslim so then they may not want to revert to Islam. This is a very bad example. One thing they must improve for this app is to make it free then this app will be the number 1 app for Islam knowledge.
